conclusion: SharedAttackPropCatalog is not the only unbounded static generated cache. Six shared catalogs lack final generated Texture/Sprite release. They require explicit root lifetime/acquisition coordination while preserving live borrowers and legacy/test fallback. Existing per-instance cleanup should not be moved merely because helper methods are static.
limits: No Unity operations/object counts or asset generation performed.
Inventory focuses generated Texture/Sprite/Material ownership in inspected presentation paths; not a guarantee of every Unity native allocation in the project.
Stage10 settings screens add UI GameObjects/Graphics but do not themselves create Texture2D/Sprite caches.
